rule: ARM 'Pick rule' (pre-registered, commit cb04f86a). G lines from readout.g_line with the frozen G rule (slopes b2, ledge_down b2, es1-2 vs TDR's RT9 rows). Suite lines from gate_read.zero_kg_check on es1 and es2, drift 0 (vs TDR's RT6 R_suite rows). z(c) = min over the 22 decisive suite lines (11 per seed) of (margin - worse_by) / se_diff, each line's own se_diff from the same call (se_diff 0: +inf if worse_by <= margin else -inf; a missing line: -inf). Q = slopes gains and ledge_down gains and neither regresses. E = Q and z > 0. Tier 1: E members with z >= 1 -> largest ledge_down diff. Tier 2: E non-empty -> largest z. Tier 3: Q non-empty -> largest z in Q, flag 'R tracking predicted marginal'. Ties: ledge_down diff within 0.010 (tier 1) or z within 0.1 (tiers 2-3) -> fewer iterations, then seed 19. Q empty -> stop and ask.
